cases.evidence_note: Mutation fixture (lane mrental), predicted by hand from the archived sources before running the evaluator. Excess business loss screen (i1040sc p. 1 and i1040se p. 1, Reminders; threshold $313,000 single, Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.32). Under the project's recorded reading amb.2025.s1_ebl_rental (docs/provisional/DECISIONS.md D15) a Schedule E rental loss before the passive activity limit counts toward the screen. Schedule C loss 310,000 (line 18 expenses, no income) plus the rental loss of 5,000 is 315,000, more than 313,000: Schedule 1 line 3 is refused at s1.ebl (Form 461).

s1.line3.remedy: A Schedule C loss above the excess business loss threshold is outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 1, Reminders, Excess business loss limitation; rp-2024-40 section 2.32
